Answer.description:
The answer to one question. Which fields appear depends on the question
kind and the answer state (spec section 4.2).

defaulted.description:
The selection is the question's default and the person never edited
the question.

oneOf.description: The person submitted, possibly with skipped questions.
The person rejected the whole session.
Answers in progress; never found in the outbox.

UnsentDraft.description:
The answers and the note of a draft that was never sent, as the `draft`
field of a withdrawn result carries them.

answers.description:
The questions with an answer, an untouched default included, or a
note, in session order and in the shape of a submitted result.

note.description: The person's note to the whole session, trimmed; absent when blank.

description:
The file asqr writes into the outbox when a session is finished, or into
`drafts/` while it is being answered.

answers.description:
A submitted result holds every question once, in session order,
apart from info items: an info item takes no answer and appears only
with a note. A cancelled result holds only the questions with an
answer, an untouched default included, or a note, in session order.
An error result and a withdrawn result hold none.

current.description: The question the cursor was on, so a restored draft continues there.

draft.description:
A withdrawn result's unsent draft: what the person had answered and
noted when the asker withdrew the session. These are no decisions,
as the person never sent them; they may only serve as presets in a
replacement session. Absent when the person had entered nothing.

error.description: What is wrong with an invalid session file.

note.description:
The person's note to the whole session, given on the review tab. A
submitted or cancelled result carries it; a draft keeps it as typed.

reason.description: Why the person rejected the session, if they said so.

session_sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of the session file's bytes as read from the inbox. It
ties the result to one version of a session that may have been
replaced, and lets recovery tell an interrupted finish from a new
session under the same id (spec section 5.7). Absent in drafts.

submitted_at.description:
When the session was finished, as RFC 3339 with the offset. Absent in
drafts.
